what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in Ethiopia.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 317879 Somali refugees in Ethiopia, 35.6% of all Somali refugees.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in several periods since 1982.
From 1986 to 1996 the groups fighting the government include the SNM, the SPM and the USC/SNA; from 2006 to 2025 they include Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam, at war level in most years since 2007.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Ethiopia peaked at 513950 in 1991 and fell to 15901 by 2005.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1988 to 1992, 1994 to 1996, 2018 and 2023 to 2025.
Returns from Ethiopia to Somalia were highest in 2001 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Ethiopia only.
People displaced inside Somalia are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Ethiopia they live.
